DECISION: reach-target-candidate-build-20261023
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Proceed now with the isolated, off-by-default target-candidate repair and independent adversarial review. No production adoption, training or model-loading/physics run is authorized by this build decision. r2 remains held. Do not expand this into a new planner framework.

Evidence accepted: PhysicalTrustRegion clamps free-body candidate positions about its baseline and copies decoder-inert fields from iteration0. The direct target was excluded by that construction. This identifies a search-coverage limitation, not proof that the predictor would choose it or that it explains the whole miss. Correct the trace's overstatement:12of45 position axes at the bound does not prove every moved position row was at its edge. Also distinguish bounds on the pre-execution candidate from the recorded post-smoothing difference; do not generalize0.63cm to every future command without the previous-command relationship.

Concrete implementation:
1. Add ONE separately evaluated target-derived candidate alongside the existing ordinary search winner and iteration0 fallback. Do not pass the new candidate through the existing motor-centered trust region, which would clip it back near the old command. Leave the ordinary search's region unchanged. Label explicitly that the additional candidate lies outside that region; do not present it as predictor-validated territory. No extra Adam search around the new target in this first repair.
2. Construct from the same selected saved world target and current iteration0 composite, with exact units. Preserve gaze, finger joint goals, mask, strengths, radius and decoder-inert values. Only decoder-active body target fields change. The baseline D also changed some inert predictor inputs; therefore the new candidate is not byte-identical to that baseline. Record that difference instead of hiding it. Preserve existing joint/feasibility checks; a saved pose is not a guarantee of reachable motion from the current state.
3. Score the actual candidate after the SAME execution conversion/smoothing used at dispatch, exactly once, using the same previous executed command and achieved pose. Capture raw candidate, transformed command, predicted pose and score. Verify dispatched command equals what was scored on decoder-active fields. No double smoothing or manually blended quaternion shortcut.
4. Keep pose_primary_improved and pose_return_keep, finite/valid-target checks and fallback semantics. Compare candidates per body against the SAME original iteration0 and measured-start baselines, not a new baseline reset to the target seed. Deterministic ties keep the ordinary winner. An invalid or rejected target candidate must leave the old result intact. Keep normal decoder feasibility and finger/eye behavior.
5. Focused checks must cover target farther than1.8cm remaining distinct, proper units/frame, execution/scoring equality, invalid/nonfinite fallback, per-body selection, ties and unchanged behavior with switch off. Obtain independent review of these specific gaps before a runtime proposal; record remaining failures honestly.

Next comparison package: use the existing8selected starts first, not72 captures. Prepare a single bounded comparison that records the old winner's and new candidate's predictions, actual selected command and its resulting movement through the real selection/dispatch path. A smoothed-D arm forced past the chooser cannot establish that the repaired planner works. Reuse the original fixed target/horizon and report250ms outcomes; specify exact schedule before proposing longer held-command results. Reuse existing baseline outcomes only where start/state/command identity matches. Do not change planner frequency and target locality together. One900second cumulative execution allowance is the design ceiling for loading, focused checks, inference, physical comparison and closure; no separate900s for each subtask. Return concrete package/hashes, measured cost basis and stop/save plan for runtime decision. No72capture score survey now.

Launcher: accept the reported focused check as evidence of the repaired detachment, with raw review/check receipts retained. Correct its budget wording: my60seconds was total executable check including runner checks/end writes, not only the child. Report actual total from existing receipts; do not rerun just to relabel. Future launch uses the reviewed exact version. Historical reconstructed source copies must remain labelled reconstructed/hash-matched, not contemporaneously saved.

Disposition approved for EXACTLY the first TWO proven-copy paths in authorized_runtime_20261023/tmp_equivalence.json:
D:\UEMA_scratch\h84\d1_planner_recovery\attempts\reach_baseline_8start_a1\tmp\inputs\ckpt_step_496250_f3b30525a71743f78cd4073be0093361.pt.gz
D:\UEMA_scratch\h84\d1_planner_recovery\attempts\reach_baseline_8start_a1\tmp\inputs\ckpt_step_496250_f3b30525a71743f78cd4073be0093361.pt
The builder may remove these1,470,237,125bytes through normal permissions after rechecking literal resolved paths within that exact tmp/inputs directory, no reparse redirection, no active consumer, source copy hashes unchanged and protected original present/hash-matching. Retain the equivalence receipt and all result evidence. Native PowerShell Remove-Item -LiteralPath for these two files only; no recursive parent removal, ACL change or forced process stop. If permission denies, report and use supported approval; no alternate-route retry. Keep the compiled model and scene files: decompressed model bytes differ, so they are not proven duplicates.

Update existing D1 and planner records with this repair as in progress, not adopted. Existing page owner should add the result and plain cause: the search only allowed small changes around its first command; the new choice offers the saved target directly and must still survive prediction and physical checks. Avoid another long status report. Installer recreation is attributed; no machine-setting change authorized. Return one reviewed repair package and disposition/check receipt; no acknowledgement-only loop.
